RaggieSoft Labs • Compiler Design, Bytecode VMs & Lore-to-Reality R&D

RaggieSoft Labs — Experimental Compilers & Systems Research

At RaggieSoft, ideas regularly cross the boundary between narrative worldbuilding and working MIT-licensed software. RaggieSoft Labs is our open engineering incubator for domain-specific compilers, capability-gated bytecode virtual machines, and upcoming candidates for the RaggieSoft Studio product line.

Enter Fin# (Financial Sharp) Lab → RaggieScript (.rssc) Playground → v0.6.0 Win32 Lab Previews →

Active Incubator Tracks

Lab Track 01 • Active Compiler Design

Fin# (Financial Sharp — finsc)

Inspired directly by Zoë Wren Brooks and Jordan Fuller's dining-table breakthrough in Question The Rules: The Birth of Fin# (/books/aubrie): a linear-type financial programming language on .NET / Roslyn principles where money cannot be created out of thin air, mutated outside a balanced transaction block, or rounded into thin air without triggering a compile-time error (FIN0001: ConservationOfCapitalViolationException).

Open Fin# Spec & Simulator → Cold-Start AI Spec
Lab Track 02 • Built & Verified in C++20 (x64 & ARM64)

RaggieScript (.rssc), Deferred UAC, MSI SQL & msiprism.exe

Static /MT C++20 compiler & 16-namespace Win32 VM enforcing RSW701 wizard phase isolation (powering zero-upfront-prompt Uac.Deferred commit elevation), direct relational msi.* SQL table surgery, 64-bit ffi.call, Windows Restart Manager, standalone read/write RaggieSoft MSI Prism, and official VS Code .vsix + multi-editor syntax highlighting.

Try 6-Profile Playground & Stdlib → Spec (.md)
Lab Track 03 • Shipped in Showcase Studio v0.5.0 (x64 & ARM64)

Bespoke Full-Canvas Self-Extracting Installers (_support\)

Static /MT C++20 runtime (ShowcaseStub.exe) & compiler (rssbuild.exe) marrying 1990s painted .BMP & Windows 11 FluentMica canvases (rect + polygon hotspots, Media Foundation + .vtt audio) with embedded _support\ staging, RaggieScript RSWBC2, selectable/deferred UAC, and .rsw-rollback.jnl undo journals.

Explore Showcase Studio →
Lab Track 04 • Staged in Installer Studio v0.6.0 & v0.7.0

Shared RaggieSoftVisualCanvas Designers, Turnkey RsDialog & Dual-Bar Suites

Unifies 2D WYSIWYG stage math, 8-grip resize handles, smart snap guides, keyboard-only arrow nudging, and one-click .rssc export in studio-shared/include/RaggieSoftVisualCanvas.hpp across Studio IDEs—paired with turnkey RsWelcome..RsFinish functions, non-clobbering [Environment.*] PATH rules, and monotonic Dual-Bar Suite progress!
